title: Making a case
description: Build a clear argument with claims, reasons, and evidence.

introduction.headline: Make a persuasive case
introduction.body: Practise stating a claim, supporting it with evidence, and signalling your conclusion.
introduction.bodyIt: Pratica a enunciare una tesi, sostenerla con prove e segnalare la conclusione.

vocabulary.example: Her claim is supported by recent survey data.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La sua tesi è supportata da recenti dati di sondaggio.

vocabulary.example: We need stronger evidence before we decide.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Ci servono prove più solide prima di decidere.

vocabulary.example: Demand has risen; therefore, we should expand.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La domanda è aumentata; pertanto, dovremmo espanderci.

exercises.explanation: Evidence is information or facts used to support an argument.

exercises.prompt: Demand has risen; ____, we should expand.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: Demand has risen; ____, we should expand.

review.tip: Defend one workplace change with a claim, one reason, and one piece of evidence.
